name: When is the best time to start planning for a 1031 exchange?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start planning for a 1031 exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to start planning for a 1031 exchange is well in advance of listing your relinquished property. This allows ample time to assemble your team, including a Qualified Intermediary, and to begin researching potential replacement properties without feeling rushed by the strict deadlines. Early preparation can significantly increase your chances of a successful exchange by identifying suitable options and understanding market conditions. Kelby Contreras recommends beginning discussions about your exchange strategy as soon as you consider selling an investment property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start planning for a 1031 exchange well before listing your current property to allow time for team assembly and replacement property research.
